name: Prisella the Bloodmoon
bio: One Bloodmoon wasn't enough for Prisella. She had to bask in its glow at all times. After much experimentation, she concentrated the Bloodmoon's undying energy into three perfectly shaped "mini-moons". They now orbit Prisella – bathing her in darklight as she leaps into the furthest Shreds – where no Nocturna's gone before.
